prompt: Put the daily Git loop in order.
instructions: Drag the rows into the correct sequence.

items.label: Edit files in the working directory

explanation: Edit, stage exactly what belongs, commit one logical change, push to share, pull to stay current.

prompt: Your team server dies for a day. Which setup keeps everyone committing?
options: Distributed VCS (Git): full history in every clone
Centralised VCS: the server holds history
Local VCS: history on one machine

distractor.1: Centralised stops everyone when the server dies.
distractor.2: Local history helps one person only.
distractor.3: Folders are the problem, not the fix.

explanation: Every Git clone carries full history, so commits continue offline; centralised and local setups cannot.
